newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to forecast 97/98 GDP growth of 1.9%--papers.
newsitem.headline: Japan to forecast 97/98 GDP growth of 1.9%--papers.

text.p: The Japanese government is set to announce a 1.9 percent real Gross Domestic Product growth forecast for fiscal 1997/98, starting on April 1, newspapers said on Wednesday.

The financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the Economic Planning Agency, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry and the Finance Ministry had basically agreed to the official growth estimate for 1997/98.
The 1.9 percent real growth forecast is the first government forecast below two percent and a record low forecast since it started forcasting growth in 1957/58.
The previous record low forecast was 2.4 percent for 1994/95. GDP grew 0.7 percent in real terms in that year.
